sources.title: GitHub - Abhijxxt14/tiny-transformers
sources.snippet: The model predicts the probability distribution of the next character for every single position in the input. During training, we feed the input to the model, compare its predictions to the ground-truth target using Cross Entropy Loss, and update the model weights using backpropagation to make the predictions more accurate.
